title: Sharp sign uncertainty for trigonometric polynomials
summary: We study sign uncertainty principles for trigonometric polynomials of prescribed degree $N$ with respect to a symmetric Borel measure $μ$ on the unit circle $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$. For each such measure, we determine the smallest radius of the last sign change for trigonometric polynomials with non-positive $μ$-integral.
